scientific_integrity: All mathematical claims derived for the explicitly defined random exact-propagator model; finite checks are diagnostic and not a replacement for proofs; no independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional homogeneous zero-input system, two specific shear splits, independent fair sampling, exact integrations, fixed step, mean-square norm at grid points. Does not address arbitrary splits, top Lyapunov exponents, control stability, or large-step approximation accuracy.
title: Sharp reentrant mean-square stability of randomized damped-shear time splitting
